focused_checks.capture_verifier: all 12 final captures pass; both defective native controls rejected for actual pixel defects

review_artifact.screenshots: review/visual-final-*/ and review/preview-final-*/; actual native application captures, not Figma exports
review_artifact.resource_policy: Original .fig remains canonical. No derivative design PDF/PNG exports added to Git.

resolved_failures: Unavailable QtQuick.Shapes prevented UI creation; original Figma SVG volume controls use the existing SVG plugin.
Video-surface hover and observing key filter were corrected to preserve real pointer/hotkey paths.
Media-name cache now updates before notifying QML, including filename fallback.
Pinned UPnP 1.14.31 MinGW alias recursion caused failed media-library shutdown; source guard and native regression plus subsequent normal exits verify correction.
DirectComposition video ordering and all four rectangle-clip bounds corrected; actual pixels reject both unblurred and whole-video-blurred versions.
Diagnostic wheel timestamps share the real pointer clock; the failing 200% scroll workflow passes after correction.
failed_observations: Cancelled or premature assertions remain failed attempts. A late native-menu Clear event did not produce its awaited outcome; earlier Clear evidence and final-item removal verify the required empty workflow. No universal diagnostic-menu-driver reliability is claimed.
limits: Interactive audits use an owned inactive Windows desktop and framework events, not OS input.
Composed SDR capture uses a capture-only nonactivating window outside monitor bounds; this does not verify HDR or Dolby Vision.
Qt file-picker and URL-drop paths are verified; Windows shell dialogs and native OLE drag routing are not claimed.
No physical-speaker listening test or every audio-output device is claimed.
Existing native menus retain upstream styling pending S5 and S7; S2 does not claim the complete redesign.
refactor_assessment: Existing VLC controllers own playback, queue, configuration and history. New chrome components and the bounded Windows compositor helper serve S2. Existing shared controls remain for other views; no speculative engine abstraction or separate refactoring stage is required.

evidence_applicability.reason: All redesigned player/queue/track QML, vector/font assets, engine-controller wiring and production video-backdrop/compositor paths are unchanged. Subsequent differences are license distribution metadata, a diagnostic-only wheel timestamp, and bound initialization callbacks in three existing miniplayer/navigation files. The final normal runtime regression freshly verifies the affected startup/EOF/destruction path with all diagnostic code excluded.
